title: Amazon to Close Mechanical Turk, the Crowdsourcing Service Bezos Dubbed 'Artificial Artificial Intelligence'
summary: Amazon is shutting down Mechanical Turk, its pioneering micro-task marketplace that allowed humans to perform discrete data tasks for nominal fees. Famously referred to by Jeff Bezos as 'artificial artificial intelligence' for using human intelligence to power digital processes, its sunset marks the end of an era in early internet history.
point1: Launched in 2005, Mechanical Turk was a vital precursor to modern AI data labeling workflows.
point2: The shutdown highlights the shift toward advanced, automated AI systems that no longer rely heavily on cheap human micro-labor.
point3: Gig workers and researchers relying on the service for data generation must find alternative platforms.
